attributes: Within every scope and every arm preserve identical IDs/order, baseline RGB/SH/opacity and canonical local covariance Sigma_y. World covariance follows rigid rotation. Native filter and model are not rerun.
covariance_control: Office2 only: four C arms on the original fixed 20 fusion views, holding world covariance at C00. Diagnostic control; separate from rigid covariance transport. No appearance/covariance refit.
alignment: Reuse original prefix position-only gauge and final pose revision from A1-U. No new GT fit, no per-KF scale fit. C00 identical to existing A00 for each scope.

evaluation.renderer: Existing E4 compact CUDA, expected camera-Z, float32, TF32 off
evaluation.primary: Equal-view mean MAE on fixed-reference-valid all-four-C-arm common covered target pixels; retain zero-support views as unscorable and publish denominators
evaluation.group_masks: C common4; C+CZ common6; prior A common4 replay; A+C common8 for representation comparison; transported+fixed-world C common8 on office2 20 views. Do not compare effects across unequal target masks as if identical.
evaluation.coverage: All reference-valid denominator, with correct coverage threshold max(abs tolerance,2% reference Z). Publish per-arm own-covered errors, depth bins, per-view and tracking-gap strata.
evaluation.office_surface: Reuse original 20-view GT-depth TSDF sampled reference and same 4cm voxel/12cm truncation/10m maximum/100k seed0 area samples for six transported C/CZ maps. Gaussian centers remain separate proxies.
evaluation.HK_surface: Sparse LiDAR and Terra reference only; no dense mesh completion or TSDF claim
evaluation.RGB: Unchanged degree-zero appearance, no refiner; same exposure-normalized target convention as prior A0/A0b. PSNR/SSIM secondary.
evaluation.prior_replay: Recompute original four-arm outcomes and original common masks from hash-verified full prior depth/coverage caches on all registered views. Independently CUDA re-render prior maps at five fixed saved views and compare depth/coverage to caches. This is not a new full-frame original model inference.
evaluation.significance: Development diagnostics only; no independent-frame/point significance or scene-level CI from these two previously used scenes
